artwork.description: statue by James Earle Fraser in Washington, D.C., United States

prompt: Square-format documentary photograph of a monumental, weathered golden-brown bronze sculpture atop a massive rectangular white stone pedestal outdoors. A powerful winged Pegasus rears toward the right, its enormous layered feathered wing extending horizontally left, behind a slender classical nude male figure holding a long narrow staff and drapery. Scroll-like bronze forms cluster near the horse's feet. The pedestal has thirteen small golden five-pointed stars across its upper front, two faint rectangular plaques, gray rain streaks and stained marble. Bright clear pale-blue sky, leafy green trees framing both sides, low stone balustrades. Warm late-afternoon sunlight from the left, realistic photographic sharpness, subtly aged bronze patina, vertical monument centered within square framing.
